items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: It was nice to see Al and here's what really happened. Al Hibbler and Art, they used to get in arguments, you know, friendly arguments

ctx.x: Oh, well, yes. This happened to be -- this took place out in Los Angeles. In fact, we -- I was working with Art at the Streets of Paris and of course, a lot of our friends used to come by to see us on the job. This particular time, I want to remember, is if you can remember the singer Al Hibbler --
